groups.rationale: The cache-publishing workflow evaluates the flake with --keep-going to report every evaluation failure; no chapter, domain or topology changes.

Mechanical case-preserving rename of the retired project name kittens/Kittens/KITTENS to overalls/Overalls/OVERALLS across sources, handbook chapters and scenarios (user-directed), including renaming the 2026-09-24 nekomo redesign review file. Two identity values were deliberately kept: the kittens.lilly.host.v1 HMAC domain that derives enrolled host machine IDs, and the sops key in secrets/dungarees-fleet-monitor.enc.json. No behavior, configuration, protocol or evidence claim changes.
